info.title: New York workers' compensation claims by county and accident year: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
New York workers' compensation claims by county and accident year: Workers' compensation claims assembled by the New York State Workers' Compensation Board in every New York county, for each accident year from 2000: the number of claims, how many have an attorney or representative (count and share), how many are controverted, how many have had a hearing and how many hearings were held, and how many are classified permanent partial or permanent total disability or occupational disease. Built only from SoQL aggregates of the Board's 5.7-million-claim file on NY Open Data (no claim-level row is read), with every count of 1 to 10 claims suppressed.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
